source: chao-garden-conversion.md (2026-10-25) + docs/garden-mode-spec.md + src/lib/mochiichao-systems.ts (HAVE in code: GardenStats, alignmentFromCare ±25 band, gardenForm thresholds 150/300, gardenBattleBonus cap +9%, typeVariant 20-point lead, dataRevert halving)
coreRule: Garden growth is a SECOND layer on top of species evolution, never a replacement. Garden Form is palette + accessories + aura + small stat bonus on the same species. Roster stays 47. Breeding never creates a hybrid species.

gardenStats.range: 1-99 in conversion doc; 0-99 clamped in mochiichao-systems.ts applyGardenItem (code clamps 0-99 — conversion doc says 1-99; discrepancy flagged, code wins until Mars rules)

dataShards.note: Chao Chaos Drives -> Data Shards. Clean stat training, no cosmetic change. Earned by defeating corrupted data / Hackers.
dataShards.shaped: 7/7 shard types named in conversion doc

gardenCritters.note: Original Mochiichao helpers, NOT Sega animals. Parts in slots Head/Back/Feet/Tail/Ears, persist through Rebirth. Critters do NOT become roster species. Conversion doc names 4 examples and requires 21 types for Mythic Form — the other 17 types are UNNAMED in the doc and are NOT invented here.
gardenCritters.shaped: 4/21 critter types named (19%); 17/21 slots held empty, NOT invented

alignment.codeBand: alignmentFromCare: >=+25 Bright, <=-25 Umbral, else Neutral (mochiichao-systems.ts — HAVE in code)
alignment.rule: Player does NOT join the Syndicate.

dataCocoonGardenForm.note: Data Cocoon -> Garden Form I/II. Form, NOT a species change. NOT 15 full sprites per species (47 x 15 = 705 sprites is unbuildable per conversion doc): one base sprite per species + palette swap + accessory overlay + aura.

formI.lock: 20 Critters or 40 Shards locks a type

dataCocoonGardenForm.formII: gradual adult change, same system as Chao second evolution; Form I + Form II = palette + accessory + aura layers
dataCocoonGardenForm.codeThresholds: gardenForm(): Form I at Garden-stat total 150, Form II at 300 (mochiichao-systems.ts — HAVE in code; conversion-doc slider/lock rules are the fuller spec and are NOT yet in code)

dataRebirth.gardenYear: 1 in-game week / ~60 min active garden time
dataRebirth.bondAbove50: Rebirth Egg: same name, Lv. 1, points / 10, parts/palette kept, grades kept
dataRebirth.bondAtOrBelow50: grey cocoon warning first: Last-Chance window to feed/pet over threshold; if it still fails, Memorial entry in MochiDex + Legacy Egg at base stats
dataRebirth.codeEquivalent: dataRevert() in mochiichao-systems.ts halves Garden stats and keeps colorway/parts (HAVE in code; full Rebirth Egg/Memorial flow is NOT in code)

requirements: all 21 Garden Critter types collected in current life
mythicForm.success: glowing Mythic Form, immortal (no death timer), cannot breed, Garden Stats locked
mythicForm.canonNote: Mythar is the template / first Mythic in canon, but any species can earn a Mythic Form — it does NOT overwrite Mythar's species entry (331)
mythicForm.carriesToGame: unlocks Burst move in Creature Mode, permanent aura

bondingSeasonHeartBerry.rule: adults only, Garden Form I+ required
bondingSeasonHeartBerry.heartBerry: rare Market/farm reward, last bite triggers, one per parent
bondingSeasonHeartBerry.freeEggs: 1 free egg per life; Heart Berries allow extra eggs
bondingSeasonHeartBerry.MARS_ONLY_BLOCKER: Garden breeding parent + fruit map is Mars-only — NOT filled here. See breeding-shape.json. Do NOT guess it.

mochikoAcademy.lessonEffect: unlock Garden idle animations and +Bond, NOT battle power

market.name: Silicon Town Market (Black Market)
market.stockRotation: every in-game day / after Trainer quests
market.unlockTiers: by Dojo Badges and quest emblems
market.neverSells: roster species — only palette eggs of species already in MochiDex
market.inGameNow: PLACEHOLDER in GardenView; ShopView is the working shop for now

races.name: MochiiPlex Circuit
races.rewards: Medals unlock toys, market tiers, training points

dojoSparring.name: MochiiPlex Dojo (Karate)
dojoSparring.rewards: training points and titles, NOT XP
dojoSparring.inGameNow: PLACEHOLDER in GardenView; Battle is the working sparring path for now

dataFruitFarming.loop: Shake -> harvest -> feed. Regrow 1 in-game day (or ~7 min active time).

specials.name: element fruit
specials.effect: per element, e.g. Aqua Melon, Flora Berry, Chrome Nut

dataFruitFarming.MARS_ONLY_BLOCKER: Full fruit->stat map is Mars-only — the GardenView placeholder buttons (Aqua/Aero/Swift/Chrome/Earth Fruit +10) are PLACEHOLDER values, NOT the canon map. Do NOT treat them as canon.
dataFruitFarming.inGameNow: PLACEHOLDER harvest buttons in GardenView only; Farm Plots place is PLACEHOLDER text
dataFruitFarming.shaped: specials 5/5 categories named; full per-fruit map BLOCKED (Mars-only)

gradesAndInheritance.grades: E -> S per Garden Stat, plus Bond, favourite Data-Fruit, personality sliders (Kind / Bold / Curious)
gradesAndInheritance.childInherits: 50% genes from each parent; higher grade wins visible grade 70% when parents differ; recessive grades can reappear in grandchildren
gradesAndInheritance.twoTone: primary palette from one parent, accent from other
gradesAndInheritance.preEvolutionTraining: training in dominant stat can bump that grade one step

carriesToMainGame: Garden Stat levels -> capped battle bonus: +1% per 10 Garden levels per stat, max +9% at Lv. 99, applied to matching battle stat (code: gardenBattleBonus, cap +9% — HAVE)
Garden Form palette/accessories/aura visible in battle
Bond hearts -> small crit/dodge bonus in Creature Mode, recruit chance in Dungeon recruitment
Grades -> growth rate in Trainer Mode (S-grade gains Garden Stat points faster, NOT battle XP faster)
Mythic Form -> Burst move in Creature Mode, permanent aura
Races/Sparring wins, Market unlocks, farm produce (fruit -> Trainer Mode healing/crafting items)
doesNotCarryOrReplace: Garden Races and Dojo Sparring never replace Trainer/Creature battles
Garden Forms never change species ID or evolution line
No Garden item required to finish story
Garden creatures live on in-game time only while save is loaded — no real-time death while away (deliberate change from Chao's clock)
gardenMinuteToMinute: Enter garden -> check need icons (! hungry, Z sleepy, flower ring = Bonding Season, cocoon timer) -> shake 3 trees, pick fruit, feed (favourite = 2x Bond, Strong Nut = Endurance, Bright/Umbral Berries = alignment; don't wake sleepers, don't snatch food) -> train with Shards (clean) or Critters (stats + parts) watching Dive<->Glide and Sprint<->Might sliders -> play (pet +Bond, toys, training dummy, Data Lesson) -> race / spar / breed -> leave.
